name: NotebookEdit
description: Edit a Jupyter `.ipynb` notebook cell. Three edit modes: `replace` (default) swaps the `source` of the cell identified by `cell_id` (code cells reset `execution_count` to null and `outputs` to []); `insert` adds a new cell after `cell_id` (or at the start of the notebook when `cell_id` is omitted) with the given `cell_type` (default `code`) and `new_source`; `delete` removes the cell identified by `cell_id`. The notebook is rewritten in place; /rewind captures the pre-edit snapshot.

notebook_path.description: Absolute path to the .ipynb file to edit

cell_id.description: Id of the cell to target. Required for `replace` and `delete`; optional for `insert` (omit to prepend a new cell at the start of the notebook).

new_source.description: New source content for the cell (required for replace and insert)

cell_type.description: Cell type (`code` or `markdown`). For `replace`, must match the current cell type — type conversion is not supported. For `insert`, defaults to `code` when omitted.
